capabilities: Measure LIX readability of a note against a chosen target band
Show live score, band and verdict in the status bar
Explain scores per section, paragraph and sentence with click-to-jump
Score folders or multi-note selections with a combined score
Write readability properties for Bases views (opt-in)
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. All scoring is local: no network calls, accounts or API keys. The structure-and-cohesion hints and Bases property writing are experimental and off by default. LIX is not meaningful for CJK text or keyword-style notes without running prose.
motivation: The author wanted to replace guessing about audience fit with a live signal: existing tools give English-only formulas or thirty raw numbers without a verdict.
problem: Obsidian has no readability feedback, and existing formulas are English-only or present raw numbers without a verdict, so writers can't tell if their audience will follow the text.

relations.evidence: Voxtral Transcribe — from the same workshop.
Parallax — also from the same workshop.

summary: LIX-based readability meter that shows an on-target verdict in the status bar and explains scores per section, paragraph and sentence.
